BUTTON HELP.Attacking - Simple: The core attacking inputs every outfield player uses in every match: the basic pass and shot family, plus the fakes that sell a dribble. Start with Ground Pass / Header and Through Pass, then learn Finesse Shot and Power Shot for finishing, and Fake Shot to buy yourself a yard in the box.
BUTTON HELP.Attacking - Advanced: The bigger attacking toolkit: weighted and driven passing variants, ways to move teammates, and the flair options. Pro Clubs players lean on Trigger Run and Call for Support to shape a move, Driven Ground Pass and Lobbed Through Pass to break lines, and Player Lock to make a run of their own while a teammate holds the ball.
BUTTON HELP.Movement: How your player carries and receives the ball when no pass or shot is involved. Sprint and Controlled Sprint decide how much of the ball you keep at pace, First Touch / Knock-On and Controlled First Touch / Effort Touch decide how the first contact lands, and Strafe Dribble lets you face goal while shuffling sideways past a marker.
BUTTON HELP.Tactics: In-match tactical changes, which in Pro Clubs mostly matter to whoever is captaining the side. Quick Tactics opens the shortcuts for Offside Trap, Team Press and Get In Box, while My Tactics swaps in one of your saved custom setups without pausing the game.
BUTTON HELP.Defending: Everything you do without the ball: switching, tackling, clearing and pulling the goalkeeper off the line. Hard Tackle, Sliding Tackle and Shoulder Challenge / Sealout are the bread-and-butter challenges, Sprint Jockey is how you stay goal-side of a quicker winger, and Professional Foul is the deliberate one for when the runner is through.
BUTTON HELP.Goalkeeper: Distribution and positioning for anyone playing in goal, with the ball in your hands or at your feet. Throw / Pass and Driven Throw get the ball out quickly, Drop Kick clears the lines, and Move Goalkeeper plus GK Cover Far Post are the manual positioning options for crosses and set pieces.
BUTTON HELP.Set Pieces - Free Kicks: The basic free-kick controls for both the taker and the defending side. Aim and Reticle Aim set where the ball goes, and Select Kick Taker decides who stands over it. If you are in the wall, Wall Jump and Wall Charge are the two things you can do as the kick is struck.
BUTTON HELP.Set Pieces - Free Kicks - Advanced: Multi-taker routines and the free-kick tactics menu. Call 2nd Kick Taker and Call 3rd Kick Taker bring extra players to the ball, 2nd Kick Taker Run Over Ball sells the dummy, and Display Free Kick Tactics opens the options for adding runners or setting the defence. Co-op change Set Piece user is the one that matters in Clubs, since it lets a different user take the kick.
BUTTON HELP.Set Pieces - Corners & Throw Ins: Corners and throw-ins, attacking and defending. Corners - Lob Cross is the standard delivery, with Display Corner Tactics for sending runners to a post or switching the defence between zonal and player marking. From a throw, Short Throw In and Long Throw In cover most situations, and Fake Throw buys a second against a tight press.
BUTTON HELP.Set Pieces - Penalties: Penalties from both ends, whether in a shootout or during the match. The taker has Aim, Shoot and Finesse Shot to choose between, while the keeper reads the run-up with Goalkeeper Move Side to Side and commits with Goalkeeper Dive. Pick your spot before the run-up and commit to it.
BUTTON HELP.Be A Pro: Player (Attacking Off The Ball: The page most specific to Pro Clubs: what you can ask for while a teammate has the ball. Call for Pass and Call for or suggest Through Pass are the everyday ones, Call for Lobbed Through Pass asks for a ball over the top, Call for Ground Cross tells the winger to keep it low, and Suggest Shot nudges a teammate to pull the trigger.
BUTTON HELP.Be A Pro: Goalkeeper (Attacking Off The: What a Clubs goalkeeper can do while their team is attacking at the other end. Suggest Through Pass, Suggest Cross and Suggest Shot let you prompt teammates from the back, Autopositioning lets the game position you so you can watch the play, and Toggle Camera Target switches what the camera follows.
BUTTON HELP.Be A Pro: Goalkeeper (Defending Own Box): The goalkeeper's controls when the ball is in or near your own box. Dive is the committed save, Punch / Reaction Save and Grab Ball handle crosses and loose balls, Rush closes down a striker who is through, and Reaction Dive On Demand forces an immediate dive rather than waiting for the game to trigger one.

Skill Moves.1 Star Moves: The one-star page is the shortest tier, a handful of fakes and quick turns rather than flair. Directional Nutmeg goes straight through a defender who has squared up, First Time Feint Turn spins you off your first touch, Open Up Fake Shot Left and Giant Fake Shot (Standing) buy a yard in the box, and Flick Up for Volley lifts the ball for a first-time strike.
Skill Moves.2 Star Moves: Two-star moves are the everyday dribbling toolkit: Body Feint Right, Stepover Left and the Ball Roll Left that wide players live on, each with a mirrored version on the same page. Drag Back and Stop And Go are the tier's stop-start moves, for killing your momentum with a defender closing and going again in a new direction.
Skill Moves.3 Star Moves: Three-star moves start turning defenders instead of just shifting the ball. Roulette Right and Roulette Left are the classic spin out of a tackle, Fake Left & Go Right sells one way and exits the other, and Heel Flick knocks the ball on past a lunging leg. Heel Chop Left (while running) needs you already at pace, as its name says.
Skill Moves.4 Star Moves: Four-star is the longest page on the screen, and most of it is close-control work: Lane Change Left and Ball Roll Cut Right shift the ball sideways without breaking stride. Fake Pass (while standing) and Ball Hop (while standing) only fire from a standstill, and Simple Rainbow lifts the ball clean over a sliding tackle.
Skill Moves.5 Star Moves: Five-star is the flair tier, the top of the skill-move ladder. Elastico is the practical one, Hocus Pocus and Triple Elastico are the showpieces, and Sombrero Flick (while standing) and Rabona Fake (while jogging) only trigger in the state their names describe. Every entry is animated, so watch the ball path before you commit it to a match.
Skill Moves.Juggling Tricks: Juggling Tricks is not a star tier: every move here assumes the ball is already up and you are keeping it there. Around the World and T. Around the World are the classic keepie-uppie spins, In Air Elastico and Chest Flick work the ball while it is airborne, and Sombrero Flick Left lifts it over whoever is standing to your left.

Celebrations.Celebrations Basics: Three controls to learn before anything else. Signature Celebration plays the one assigned to your Pro, Random Celebration picks for you, and Cancel Celebration cuts the animation short when you would rather get on with the restart. Every other tab on this page builds on these.
Celebrations.Running Moves: Running moves play while your Pro is still on the move after the goal, before a finishing move takes over. The set covers the classics, Thumb Suck, Aeroplane and Windmill, alongside crowd gestures like Come On! and Blow Kisses. Pick one you can start without thinking, then let a finishing move close it out.
Celebrations.Finishing Moves: Finishing moves are the full stop on a goal, the animation that plays once your Pro pulls up. It is the biggest tab here: player signatures like Mohamed Salah and James Tarkowski, camera pieces such as Selfie (Next To Adboard), and the standards every club runs, from Knee Slide to Spanish Dance. If you only learn one page, make it this one.
Celebrations.Pro Unlockables: Pro Unlockables are the celebrations tied to your Pro's own progression, so a fresh Pro will not have all of them yet. The page leans acrobatic and playful: Backflips, Ice Skating and Golf Swing sit next to quieter picks like Kiss The Ground. One entry, Relax (Offline Only), is exactly what its name says, so do not plan a Clubs match around it.
Celebrations.EAS FC Unlockables: EAS FC Unlockables are the celebrations earned through the game's seasonal rewards rather than your Pro, so what you have depends on what you have claimed. It is the smaller unlockable set but a loud one: Rock On, Predator, Power Slide and Jump Dance all live here, along with Calm Down (Offline Only), which will not fire in a Clubs match.
